name: app-blue-call-app-held-below-woman-ghost-lettering
title: Blue Calls App with Low-Angle Portrait
whatItIs: A cover with a phone in a hand extended toward the camera showing a blue call-statistics gauge, a woman in a dark blazer behind, and giant translucent 'SOFTPHONE' lettering above.
whatItMeans: The low angle and outstretched hand make the phone feel immediate, and the blue gradient keeps it corporate yet energetic.
techniques: Phone pushed toward the viewer for depth
Ghost brand name across the top
Blue semicircle gauge as key graphic
Small pill labels in the corners

vocabulary.definition: Making a near object look large by proximity to the camera.
Oversized faint brand text behind a subject.
